description: Get your personalized daily lead recommendations based on your targeting preferences. Returns AI-scored companies that match your ideal customer profile. A new list is built every day, weekends included, and each day's list stands alone (Monday's list does not repeat Saturday's or Sunday's). To catch up on days you missed, pass days (e.g. days: 3 on a Monday returns Saturday, Sunday and Monday). For "who should I reach out to": get_lead_detail on the strongest few, then give a short ranked action plan: the dated event, why it fits (Timing, Relevance, Relationships), who to contact (who_do_i_know first for a warm intro, then get_company_contacts) and the first line of an opener. Say when a lead's fit is weak rather than padding the list.

days.description: How many days of daily lists to return, counting today (1 = today only, the default; 3 on a Monday = the weekend plus today; max 14). With icp "all" the result opens with how many companies each ICP returned, so a thin ICP is visible at once.

icp.description: Which ICP's list. Omit for the main ICP. Pass an extra ICP's name or id (get_targeting_preferences lists them, e.g. "ICP2") for that list alone, or "all" for the main list plus every active extra ICP merged, one row per company, each tagged with the ICP(s) that picked it.

name: get_daily_leads
title: Get daily leads
